_note: Store/native version source of truth for the soft 'Update available' prompt. For each STORE release, bump BOTH `latest_version` AND `latest_version_code` to the values of the binary you ACTUALLY UPLOADED — read them from android/app/build.gradle (versionName / versionCode) and ios/*/Info.plist, NOT from app.config.js, which drifts whenever the native project is edited without a prebuild. A stale latest_version_code is what silently killed the 1.0.4 prompt: it was left at 8 (the 1.0.1 release) while the store build was 11. `show_again_after_days` re-shows a dismissed update after N days. This is the NATIVE store version, NOT the OTA bundle version in production.json. Replace the iOS id000000000 placeholder with the real numeric App Store ID once the app is live.
